solution: Walk down the bridge just to the west of the northern entrance to Port Phasmatys and dig next to the mushroom. The exact location is directly on top of the mushroom but any square around it works.
travel:
* Ectophial.
* Canifis lodestone.
* Fairy ring and run east to Port Phasmatys.

clue: Don't skip here
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Don't skip here.png
title: Don't skip here, it's too muddy. You'll feel like a star if you dig here, though.
solution: Go to the southern tip of Mudskipper Point and dig on the south-eastern starfish.
travel:
* Fairy ring (code ).
* Port Sarim lodestone and run south.

clue: While a sea view is nice
image: Clue scroll (medium) - While a sea view is nice.png
title: While a sea view is nice, it seems this church has not seen visitors in a while. Dig outside the westmost wall by the broken fence for a reward.
solution: Dig outside, at the dirt spaces adjacent to the western wall, behind the altar in the church south-east Rimmington and south-west of Port Sarim. One pace north-east of the location pictured.
travel:
* Port Sarim lodestone, then run southwest.
* Fairy ring ,

clue: Observe
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Observe.png
title: Observe: in the crate just north of the stairs leading down, you will find the answer.
solution: The crate is at the top of the stairs inside the Observatory. Climb the rope on the north east side, outside the building, and enter. You could also walk through the tunnels to the Observatory.
travel:
* 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport.
* Ring of duelling or balloon transport system to Castle Wars and run north.

clue: This crate clearly marks the end of the line for coal
image: Clue scroll (medium) - This crate clearly marks the end of the line for coal.png
title: This crate clearly marks the end of the line for coal.
solution: Search the crate in the corner of the Coal truck mine's end just north of the Forester's Arms pub in Seers' Village.
travel: , then run north.

clue: For any aspiring mage
image: Clue scroll (medium) - For any aspiring mage.png
title: For any aspiring mage, I'm sure searching this bookcase will be a rewarding experience.
solution: Search the bookcase in the north-east corner of the shop on the top floor of the Mage Training Arena.
travel:
* Ring of duelling to Het's Oasis, exit west, run north, then east.
* Dig Site pendant to Exam Centre, run south.
* Al Kharid lodestone, run north past Het's Oasis, then east.

clue: This cupboard has treasure
image: Clue scroll (medium) - This cupboard has treasure.png
title: This cupboard has treasure, pirate pots and corsair cutlery!
solution: Search the cupboard in the house east of the Dead Man's Chest pirate bar in Brimhaven.
location: House east of the Dead Man's Chest bar
travel:
* Spirit tree to Brimhaven (if planted), head south to last house on left.
*, head north, east, then south.

clue: This temple is rather sluggish
image: Clue scroll (medium) - This temple is rather sluggish.png
title: This temple is rather sluggish. The chest just inside the entrance, however, is filled with goodies.
solution: Search the first chest to the east when you first enter Witchaven Dungeon.
travel:
* Ardougne Teleport takes you to the north of the Ardougne market, which is directly west of Witchaven.
* Fairy ring (code ), then run south.
* .
* Kandarin monastery Teleport.

clue: Hay
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Hay.png
title: Hay! Stop for a bit and admire the scenery, just like the tourism promoter says.
solution: Search the hay bales in the circular room south of the Baxtorian Falls, near Rasolo.
travel:
* Dwarven Outpost teleport with Dark Facet of Luck, run south-west.
* Dungeoneering cape teleport to Waterfall Dungeon (6), run south and exit. Get in the Barrel, then head north-west.
* Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, then run south.
* Ardougne lodestone, then run north-west.

clue: Being this far north
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Being this far north.png
title: Being this far north has meant that these crates have escaped being battled over.
solution: Search the crates north of the north-eastern most building in the Battlefield south of Ardougne.
travel:
* Spirit tree teleport to the Battlefield (3), then run west.
* Kandarin monastery Teleport then run west.
* Ourania Teleport then run east.

clue: The rock cakes to the south
image: Clue scroll (medium) - The rock cakes to the south.png
title: The rock cakes to the south are definitely more edible than the two rocks I buried the treasure between.
solution: Dig just north of the rock cake stall in Gu'Tanoth between the outcrop of rocks in the marketplace. One pace north of the location pictured. Requires completing part of the Watchtower quest.
travel: Gu'Tanoth Teleport, then navigate into Gu'Tanoth.

clue: The owner of this crate has a hunch
image: Clue scroll (medium) - The owner of this crate has a hunch.png
title: The owner of this crate has a hunch that he put more than fish inside.
solution: Search the crate near Lubufu south of Brimhaven.
travel:
* House Teleport (if house is in Brimhaven) or Brimhaven tablet, then run east.
*, then run north.

clue: The gnomes' nearby cart
image: Clue scroll (medium) - The gnomes' nearby cart.png
title: The gnomes' nearby cart must have collapsed under the weight of all the treasure in these boxes!
solution: West of the Outpost, south of water symbol on map. Search the south-westernmost boxes.
travel:
* Traveller's necklace to the Outpost and run west, or Sixth-Age circuit to the World Gate and run east
* Spirit tree in the Tree Gnome Stronghold
* 
*

clue: In a town where wizards are known to gather
image: Clue scroll (medium) - In a town where wizards are known to gather.png
title: In a town where wizards are known to gather, search upstairs in a large house to the north.
solution: Search the chest in the house north of the Wizards' Guild. You need to kill a man in order to get a key.
location: House north of the Wizards' Guild
travel:
* Watchtower Teleport to Yanille, then run east.
* House Teleport (if player-owned house is in Yanille) or Yanille tablet, then run east.

clue: In a town where the guards are armed with maces
image: Clue scroll (medium) - In a town where the guards are armed with maces.png
title: In a town where the guards are armed with maces, search the upstairs rooms of the public house.
solution: Go to Handelmort Mansion and kill one of the guard dogs for the key. Then go to the Flying Horse Inn just north of the Ardougne castle. Search the drawers that can be found upstairs.
travel:
* Ardougne lodestone, then run south to Handelmort Mansion to kill the guard dog, then run west to the Flying Horse Inn.
* Ardougne Teleport, then run west to Handelmort Mansion to kill the guard dog, then run west to the Flying Horse Inn.
keyhint: The drawers are locked! A note left on the drawers reads: Beware of dog!

clue: In a town where thieves steal from stalls
image: Clue scroll (medium) - In a town where thieves steal from stalls.png
title: In a town where thieves steal from stalls, search for some drawers upstairs of a house near the bank.
solution: Search the southern drawers in the of Jerico's house, where the pigeon cages are. It is directly south of the northern Ardougne bank. You must kill a level 18 Ardougne guard for the key.
travel: Ardougne lodestone, then run south.

clue: In a town where everyone has perfect vision
image: Clue scroll (medium) - In a town where everyone has perfect vision.png
title: In a town where everyone has perfect vision, seek some locked drawers in a house that sits opposite a workshop.
solution: Go to the house in Seers' Village south of the house with the anvils. The drawers will be locked, follow the road north to the Sinclair Mansion or south-west to Hemenster. Kill a chicken to get the key for the drawer.
travel: Seers' Village lodestone, then run East.
keyhint: Don't forget to feed the chickens.

clue: Search the upstairs drawers of a house
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Search the upstairs drawers of a house.png
title: Search the upstairs drawers of a house in a village where pirates are known to have a good time.
solution: In Brimhaven, go to the building east of the pub. Kill the pirate outside to get a key, then enter the building and search the drawers on the top floor.
location: House east of Dead Man's Chest
travel:
* Planted spirit tree teleport to Brimhaven, then run south.
* House Teleport (if player-owned house is in Brimhaven) or Brimhaven tablet, then run east.
* Karamja lodestone, then run north and east.

clue: Go to the village being attacked by trolls
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Go to the village being attacked by trolls.png
title: Go to the village being attacked by trolls and search the drawers in one of the houses.
solution: Go to the weapons shop in Burthorpe (next to Dunstan and his anvil). Go slightly southwest to the house directly north of the Heroes' Guild, pickpocket Penda for a key, then open the drawers on the ground floor of the weapons shop.
travel: , then run east.

clue: The dead, red dragon watches over this chest
image: Clue scroll (medium) - The dead, red dragon watches over this chest.png
title: The dead, red dragon watches over this chest. He must really dig the view.
solution: Go to Barbarian Village or the Barbarian Outpost. Kill a barbarian and collect the key they drop. Go to the Exam Centre south of the Varrock Dig Site and search the chest under the red dragon's head in the main building.
travel: Skull sceptre to Barbarian Village or Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, then Dig Site pendant or Archaeology journal to Exam Centre.
keyhint: The chest is locked! Crude graffiti on the chest reads: 'Barbarians rule, okay!'

clue: Go to this building to be illuminated
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Go to this building to be illuminated.png
title: Go to this building to be illuminated, and check the drawers while you are there.
solution: Kill a fremennik market guard to acquire a key, then search the drawers in the Lighthouse west of Rellekka. Requires the completion of Horror from the Deep and the completion of Bar Crawl (miniquest) to enter the lighthouse.
travel:
Rellekka market:
* Fremennik sea boots 4 teleport to the market.
* House Teleport (if player-owned house is in Rellekka), Rellekka tablet, or Enchanted lyre teleport to Rellekka's south entrance, then run north.
Lighthouse:
* Lighthouse Teleport.
* Games necklace to Barbarian Assault, then run north and across the basalt rocks.
keyhint: The drawers are locked! A note on the top says 'I'm guarding the key at the market'.

clue: Probably filled with wizards' socks
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Probably filled with wizards' socks.png
title: Probably filled with wizards' socks.
solution: Kill a spellwisp north-west of the Wizards' Tower to get a key. Then go to the and search the cupboard in the south-east room.
travel:
* Fairy ring .
* Wicked hood.
* Amulet of glory to Draynor Village.
* Draynor lodestone.
keyhint: This cupboard is locked! One of the Spellwisps might have stolen the key.

clue: This crate is mine
image: Clue scroll (medium) - This crate is mine.png
title: This crate is mine, all mine, even if it is in the middle of the desert.
solution: Search the crate near the wooden cart with the camel in the Desert Mining Camp, which is south of Shantay Pass. Don't forget your metal key (acquired by starting The Tourist Trap quest).
travel:
* Fairy ring (Kalphite Hive), then run south-east.
* House Teleport (if player-owned house is in Pollnivneach) or Pollnivneach tablet, then run north-west.
* Bandit Camp lodestone, then run north-east.

clue: Dig here if you are not feeling too well
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Dig here if you are not feeling too well.png
title: Dig here if you are not feeling too well after travelling through the desert. Ali heartily recommends it.
solution: Dig next to the well in Pollnivneach.
travel:
* Pollnivneach Teleport scroll.
* Pollnivneach tablet
* Use a Ring of slaying or Slayer cape to teleport to Sumona.

clue: You'll need to have Doug deep
image: Clue scroll (medium) - You'll need to have Doug deep.png
title: You'll need to have Doug deep into the distant past to get to these sacks.
solution: Search the north-west sacks just north of Doug Deeping. He is down the western winch at the Varrock Dig Site. You will need a rope the first time you do this. Just 'operate' the winch to go down (you must have completed most of The Dig Site quest to enter winch).
location: Underground at the Varrock Dig Site
travel:
* Dig Site pendant to Dig Site, then run north-west to winch.
* Archaeology journal teleport, then run north to winch.

clue: The socks in these drawers are holier than thine
image: Clue scroll (medium) - The socks in these drawers are holier than thine.png
title: The socks in these drawers are holier than thine, according to the tonsured owners.
solution: Drawers in the north-east corner of the Edgeville Monastery, downstairs. You need to kill a Monk of Zamorak to get a key.
travel:
Zamorak monk:
* Grave of Scorpius: Ourania Teleport.
* Captured Temple: Bandosian token, Mind altar teleports (Wicked hood, Ethereal outfit, Mind altar teleport), Goblin Village teleports (Goblin village sphere, Master archaeologist's outfit to General Bentnoze or General Wartface).
Edgeville Monastery:
* Combat bracelet.
keyhint: The chest has a crude note on top. It reads 'You'll never get these drawers open now! - Zamorak Monk.'

clue: There is no 'worthier' lord
title: There is no 'worthier' lord.
image: Clue scroll (hard) - There is no 'worthier' lord (before Plague's End).png
solution: Talk to Lord Iorwerth in the elven camp near Prifddinas.
travel:
* Tirannwn quiver 3 teleport directly to the camp
* Tirannwn lodestone teleport

clue: There is no 'worthier' lord
title: There is no 'worthier' lord.
image: Clue scroll (hard) - There is no 'worthier' lord (before Plague's End).png
solution: Speak to Iestin Edern in the chapel in Prifddinas.
travel: Crystal teleport seed to Iorwerth Clan (option 7 using the 'activate' function)

clue: Small shoe
image: Clue scroll (hard) - Small shoe.png
title: 'Small shoe.' Often found with rod on mushroom.
solution: Talk to any gnome trainer in the agility area of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
travel: Spirit tree teleport to Tree Gnome Stronghold, then run south-east.

clue: You'll need to look for a city with a central fountain
image: Clue scroll (medium) - You'll need to look for a city with a central fountain.png
title: You'll need to look for a city with a central fountain. Look for a locked chest in the city's chapel.
solution: Go to the Ardougne Monastery south-east of the Clock Tower (south of Ardougne) and kill a monk for the key. Afterwards go to the north-eastern church in Varrock and search for a closed chest. The correct chest reads "Property of Clock Tower Monastery" when attempting to open it.
travel:
* Kandarin monastery Teleport to Ardougne Monastery.
* 'Chipped' Varrock teleport (or Dave's spellbook) to the Varrock church.
keyhint: The chest is locked! An inscription on the chest says: Property of Clock Tower Monastery.

clue: In a land of despair
title: In a land of despair, in need of repair, find me stashed in the artisan's lair.
image: File:Clue scroll (hard) - In a land of despair.png
solution: Search the crate near the anvil in the ruins in level 22 Wilderness.
travel: This clue is currently unobtainable.

clue: My name's a tirade, fishing is my trade
image: Clue scroll (hard) - If a man carried my burden.png
title: My name's a tirade, fishing is my trade, by the docks is where my fortune is made.
solution: Talk to Gerrant in the fishing shop in Port Sarim.

clue: I am head of the abbey with a cold breeze from the west
image: Clue scroll (hard) - A bag belt only?.png
title: I am head of the abbey with a cold breeze from the west.
solution: Talk to Abbot Langley in Edgeville Monastery.
travel:
* Combat bracelet to the Edgeville Monastery (option 3.)
* Edgeville Lodestone and run west.
